eligible_user_denominator.eligible_users: all user keys in dataset.testDict constructed from users present in test.txt
eligible_user_denominator.per_user_empty_relevance_case: not represented by an empty test list in the parsed testDict construction; only parsed test-file user rows enter the dictionary
eligible_user_denominator.averaging: macro arithmetic mean across eligible testDict users

candidate_universe_and_masking.catalog_universe: all item columns returned by getUsersRating for the repository dataset, indexed 0 through m_items-1
candidate_universe_and_masking.train_seen_source: dataset.getUserPosItems(batch_users), backed by UserItemNet built from train.txt
candidate_universe_and_masking.ranking_mode: full-catalog scoring with train-seen masking, followed by top-k

relevance.definition: predicted item is relevant iff it is a member of the user's testDict positive-item list
relevance.threshold: implicit membership in the repository test split; no rating threshold is applied by the evaluator

recall_at_20.per_user_numerator: number of relevant items in the user's top-20 ranking
recall_at_20.per_user_denominator: number of relevant items in that user's testDict list
recall_at_20.aggregation: macro mean over eligible testDict users

precision_at_20.per_user_numerator: number of relevant items in the user's top-20 ranking
precision_at_20.aggregation: macro mean over eligible testDict users

ndcg_at_20.dcg: sum of discounted binary gains over the first 20 ranked positions
ndcg_at_20.idcg: sum of the same discounts for min(number of user test positives, 20) ideal relevant positions
ndcg_at_20.zero_idcg_handling: IDCG zeros are replaced with 1 before division
ndcg_at_20.aggregation: macro mean over eligible testDict users

sampling.evaluation_negative_sampling: NONE; all item scores are produced and training positives are masked
sampling.training_sampler_relevance_to_evaluator: training provenance only, not an evaluation candidate sampler
sampling.training_sampler_dispatch: utils.UniformSample_original attempts sources.sampling.sample_negative and falls back to UniformSample_original_python on exception
sampling.python_fallback: draw trainDataSize users uniformly with replacement; for each sampled user with positives, choose one train positive uniformly and repeatedly draw an item uniformly until it is not a train positive

averaging_and_reporting.per_batch_behavior: sum metric vectors returned for user batches
averaging_and_reporting.final_behavior: divide summed vectors by total eligible-user count

inferences_forbidden: Do not infer deterministic tie semantics from torch.topk.
Do not infer a sampled-negative evaluator from the existence of training samplers.
Do not infer v5 candidate-universe, mask, denominator or metric equality from similarly named metrics.
Do not treat the pinned evaluator source as proof that it produced the README row.
Do not treat printed metrics as an evaluator execution receipt.
Do not add (-score, raw_item_id) and call the result an exact official reproduction; that is a harmonized contract.
Do not execute the source's repeated test-evaluation schedule against sealed v5 TEST.
Do not import paper-surface all-ranking prose to repair missing result-bound source receipts.
